# gitmoap_repository_branch_rule (Resource)

Protects the repository's branches matching a name or a pattern, where `*` matches anything, `/` included: the access level needed to push and to merge (Developer at the lowest), whether force pushes are allowed, whether code owners must approve, and up to 50 people, service accounts or teams per allowlist who bypass the level. Maintainers and above may create one; a pattern takes one rule per repository, and a rule weaker than one a group above enforces for the same pattern is refused.

The token needs `branch_rule:manage` and `branch_rule:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch_pattern` (String)
- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Optional

- `allow_force_push` (Boolean)
- `allowed_to_merge` (String)
- `allowed_to_push` (String)
- `enforcement` (String) Whether the scopes beneath may replace a rule, or only strengthen it.
- `merge_allowlist` (List of String)
- `push_allowlist` (List of String)
- `require_code_owner_approval` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `branch_rule_id` (String) Branch rule ID
- `repository_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its repo_id and branch_rule_id, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_repository_branch_rule.example "<repo_id>/<branch_rule_id>"
```
